name: azdo-intelligence-hub
description: Azure DevOps extension: Repositories, Pipelines, Work Items, Security & User Activity dashboard

scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path ./package
scripts.package:dev: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path ./package --override "{\"public\":false}"

comments.note: Chart.js, chartjs-plugin-datalabels and xlsx are loaded via CDN <script> tags in src/index.html, not bundled — see src/index.html <head>.
